description:
Soar Duo is passionate about science, technology, space, environmental innovation and creative problem-solving. For the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, we're building the Delhi Air Jukebox an interactive experience that transforms real air-quality data into sound, helping people understand the impact of pollution during Diwali.

We're looking for skills in coding, data science, UI/UX design, environmental science, music and scientific research who want to turn data into meaningful change!
